answer: To resist sybil swarms, each agent bonds stake into a hash-linked trellis where identity weight decays with every epoch, so a rising tide of fake keys cannot concentrate voting power without proportional locked capital. An ivory-tier audit layer samples cross-shard attestations and slashes any cluster whose mutual endorsements deviate beyond the formal invariant. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
